verdict.rationale: Claude analyzes user data inside the product: it accepts CSV, XLSX, JSON and PDF uploads, including charts within PDFs [claude-docs-14, claude-docs-48], keeps project knowledge bases [claude-docs-62], and reads Drive and Gmail data via connectors [claude-docs-19]. It also generates code, visualizes data [claude-docs-41], and produces reports with charts from your documents [claude-docs-55], while Cowork and scheduled tasks deliver synthesized briefings and summaries [claude-docs-4, claude-docs-58]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of data-analysis insight quality, and evidence of proactive (unprompted) suggestions rather than prompt-driven analysis.
